import sys

def is_returnable_room(start, s, n):
    visited = [False] * n
    stack = [start]
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        if visited[current]:
            continue
        visited[current] = True
        next_clockwise = (current + 1) % n
        next_anticlockwise = (current - 1) % n
        if s[current] == '>' or s[current] == '-':
            if not visited[next_clockwise]:
                stack.append(next_clockwise)
        if s[current] == '<' or s[current] == '-':
            if not visited[next_anticlockwise]:
                stack.append(next_anticlockwise)
    return visited[start]
